references.text: Prohibition against having sexual relations with a brother's wife, which is a parallel law to Leviticus 20:21
Similar punishment of childlessness for sexual sin with an uncle's wife
Levirate marriage law allowing marriage to a brother's wife under specific circumstances (when the brother dies childless)
Herod's sons were punished for their sins, an illustration of childlessness as God's judgment
John the Baptist rebuked Herod for taking his brother's wife, referencing this prohibition
John the Baptist confronted Herod about his unlawful marriage to Herodias, his brother's wife
